interpretation: The minute-based price is an estimate; account for returned token usage. A larger per-call planning reserve may be used conservatively, but it is not a server-enforced billing cap.
implementationBoundary: The supplied transcription helper has no explicit retry-disable option and does not preserve uncertain HTTP response attempts. The local controller retains the same documented multipart fields, adds no automatic retries, and preserves each response and cost record separately.
